days.title: Going Longer Without Stopping
days.learning_objective: Stress is the body's response to challenges and demands.
learning_objectives: Identify common stressors and their physical and emotional effects.
Explain the physiological processes involved in the stress response (fight-or-flight).
Apply at least three different stress management techniques in daily life.

days.title: Bending Without Breaking
days.learning_objective: Relaxation reduces stress and restores calm.
learning_objectives: Identify personal stressors and triggers.
Demonstrate at least three different relaxation techniques.
Develop a personalized relaxation plan for daily use.

days.title: Brain and Body Working Together
days.learning_objective: Mindfulness focuses attention on the present moment.
learning_objectives: Define mindfulness and its core principles.
Practice simple mindfulness techniques, such as mindful breathing and body scans.
Identify and manage distracting thoughts and emotions in a mindful way.

days.title: How Fast You Can Respond
days.learning_objective: Meditation trains the mind to be calm and focused.
learning_objectives: Learn basic meditation techniques for beginners.
Identify and manage distracting thoughts during meditation.
Practice mindfulness and cultivate a sense of calm.

days.title: Why Water Keeps You Working
days.learning_objective: Breathing exercises calm the nervous system.
learning_objectives: Students will be able to identify at least three different breathing exercises.
Students will be able to demonstrate proper technique for each breathing exercise.
Students will be able to explain how breathing exercises impact the nervous system.

days.title: Preparing Your Body
days.learning_objective: Stretching improves flexibility and prevents injury.
learning_objectives: Identify at least 3 major muscle groups and their corresponding stretches.
Demonstrate proper stretching techniques to avoid injury.
Explain the benefits of regular stretching for physical health and performance.

days.title: How You Hold Your Body
days.learning_objective: Posture affects health, comfort, and how others perceive us.
learning_objectives: Identify the key elements of good posture.
Demonstrate exercises to improve posture and alignment.
Explain the benefits of good posture on physical and mental health.

days.title: Help Until Help Arrives
days.learning_objective: Safety practices prevent accidents and injuries.
learning_objectives: Identify common household hazards and describe strategies to mitigate them.
Demonstrate basic first aid techniques for minor injuries, like cuts and scrapes.
Apply safety rules in various environments, including home, school, and public spaces.

days.title: Avoiding Things Going Wrong
days.learning_objective: First aid provides immediate care for injuries or illness.
learning_objectives: Identify common injuries and illnesses requiring first aid.
Demonstrate proper techniques for bandaging wounds and controlling bleeding.
Describe the steps for performing CPR and administering first aid for choking.

days.title: Ready Before It Happens
days.learning_objective: Emergency preparedness helps us respond to unexpected crises.
learning_objectives: Identify potential emergency situations and their unique challenges.
Assemble a basic emergency preparedness kit with essential supplies.
Develop a family communication plan for use during emergencies.

days.title: Weighing What Could Go Wrong
days.learning_objective: Fire safety prevents fires and protects people when they occur.
learning_objectives: Identify common fire hazards in the home.
Explain the importance of smoke detectors and their maintenance.
Demonstrate a safe escape plan from a home fire.

days.title: Recognizing Real Threats
days.learning_objective: Water safety prevents drowning and water-related accidents.
learning_objectives: Identify common water hazards in various environments (pools, lakes, oceans).
Explain and demonstrate essential water safety rules (buddy system, never swim alone).
Describe basic rescue techniques and how to call for help in an emergency.

days.title: Your Body's Alarm System
days.learning_objective: Internet safety protects personal information and wellbeing online.
learning_objectives: Identify potential online risks, including phishing, malware, and cyberbullying.
Demonstrate strategies for protecting personal information online, such as creating strong passwords and being cautious about sharing data.
Apply critical thinking skills to evaluate the credibility of online sources and identify misinformation.

days.title: Worry About What Hasn't Happened
days.learning_objective: Stranger danger teaches caution with unfamiliar people.
learning_objectives: Identify characteristics of safe adults vs. strangers.
Demonstrate assertive responses when approached by a stranger.
Explain the importance of never going anywhere with a stranger.

days.title: Stopping Hurt Before It Starts
days.learning_objective: Bullying prevention creates safe, respectful environments.
learning_objectives: Define bullying and differentiate it from other forms of conflict.
Identify the different roles in a bullying situation (bully, victim, bystander, upstander).
Develop strategies for responding to bullying, both as a target and as a witness.
Promote empathy and understanding for individuals who are bullied.
Learn how to create a safe and inclusive environment in their school and community.

days.title: Asking and Respecting the Answer
days.learning_objective: Consent means freely agreeing to something without pressure.
learning_objectives: Define consent in simple terms.
Identify situations where consent is necessary.
Distinguish between enthusiastic consent and coerced agreement.

days.title: Where You End and Others Begin
days.learning_objective: Boundaries protect our physical and emotional space.
learning_objectives: Define personal boundaries and their importance.
Identify different types of boundaries (physical, emotional, mental).
Learn practical strategies for setting and maintaining healthy boundaries in various relationships.

days.title: What's Yours to Share
days.learning_objective: Privacy protects personal information and space.
learning_objectives: Define privacy and explain its importance in online and offline contexts.
Identify common threats to personal privacy, such as phishing and data breaches.
Apply practical strategies for protecting personal information, including strong passwords and privacy settings.

days.title: Who You Are
days.learning_objective: Identity is our sense of who we are.
learning_objectives: Define the concept of 'identity' in their own words.
Identify at least three personal characteristics that contribute to their identity.
Explain how personal experiences and relationships shape one's identity.

days.title: Showing Who You Are
days.learning_objective: Self-expression communicates our unique thoughts and feelings.
learning_objectives: Identify various methods of self-expression, including verbal and non-verbal communication.
Articulate personal thoughts and feelings using appropriate language and creative mediums.
Demonstrate empathy and respect for the self-expression of others.

days.title: What Makes You You
days.learning_objective: Individuality celebrates what makes each person unique.
learning_objectives: Define individuality and identify personal unique qualities.
Explain the importance of celebrating differences in oneself and others.
Apply strategies to express individuality in a positive and constructive manner.

days.title: Why Difference Matters
days.learning_objective: Diversity enriches communities with different perspectives and experiences.
learning_objectives: Define diversity and identify different types of diversity within a community.
Explain the benefits of diversity in various settings.
Demonstrate empathy and respect for individuals from diverse backgrounds.

days.title: Making Room for Everyone
days.learning_objective: Inclusion ensures everyone feels welcomed and valued.
learning_objectives: Define inclusion and explain its importance.
Identify ways to promote inclusion in everyday life.
Demonstrate empathy and understanding towards diverse perspectives.

days.title: Feeling What Others Feel
days.learning_objective: Equality treats all people with the same rights and opportunities.
learning_objectives: Define equality and differentiate it from equity.
Identify examples of inequality in various contexts (historical, social, personal).
Develop strategies to promote fairness and inclusion in their daily lives.

days.title: Caring That Becomes Action
days.learning_objective: Justice ensures fair treatment and consequences.
learning_objectives: Define justice and identify its key components.
Analyze different perspectives on fairness and equality.
Apply principles of justice to real-world scenarios and ethical dilemmas.

days.title: What Everyone Deserves
days.learning_objective: Rights are entitlements that protect human dignity.
learning_objectives: Identify three fundamental human rights and explain their importance.
Analyze real-world scenarios where rights are violated and propose solutions.
Articulate the relationship between rights, responsibilities, and human dignity.

days.title: What You Owe Others
days.learning_objective: Responsibilities are duties we owe to ourselves and others.
learning_objectives: Define responsibilities and their importance.
Identify responsibilities towards oneself and others.
Demonstrate effective strategies for managing responsibilities.

days.title: Being Part of a Place
days.learning_objective: Citizenship involves participating in and contributing to community.
learning_objectives: Define citizenship and identify its key components.
Explain different ways individuals can participate in their community.
Evaluate the importance of civic responsibility and its impact on society.

days.title: People Deciding Together
days.learning_objective: Democracy gives people a voice in how they are governed.
learning_objectives: Define democracy and identify its key characteristics.
Explain the importance of civic participation and the role of citizens in a democracy.
Compare and contrast different forms of government, highlighting the unique features of democracy.

days.title: Your Voice in Decisions
days.learning_objective: Voting allows citizens to choose their representatives.
learning_objectives: Define the concept of voting and its importance in a democracy.
Identify different types of elections and voting systems.
Explain the historical context of voting rights and suffrage movements.
